annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively promotes OneCoin packages as a way to obtain mining tokens and earn highly favorable returns, including the assurance that participants "cannot fail to make money" and that success is "almost a mathematical certainty." It also instructs viewers to build a network and promises commissions from sponsored members' package purchases, with multi-generation matching bonuses and escalating earnings. The presentation therefore solicits participation through combined investment, mining, appreciation and recruitment-dependent income claims rather than merely discussing cryptocurrency.
